name: epssura.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 161 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.epssura.com scores 40 out of 100 (F). 13 checks fail now, 41 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: 161 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 161 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /corporativo-ley-de-transparencia, /faqs, /escribenos and 82 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 1646 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 7 elements on /, /corporativo-ley-de-transparencia, for example #buscador-btn and #enterate-paginator-prev. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 90 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 2 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /autorizaciones-turno-virtual answered 404, linked from /. /plancomplementario?id=2459 answered 404, linked from /plancomplementario, /index.php/plancomplementario.
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 90 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page sets a mobile viewport
The start page reads well without JavaScript
